final_verdict.summary: Reject C2 narrowly: reopen ignores a durable nonterminal operation when the session pointer was not persisted before a crash, then admits new execution from ambiguous state.

issues.contract_requirement: interface.records: Crash disagreement fails closed on reopen; never dispatch from ambiguous state. Persist running/outstanding state before dispatch.
issues.finding: Submit durably writes the running operation before writing session.outstanding_operation_ref. A real supervisor exit at that boundary leaves a running operation and null session pointer. prepare checks only the session pointer and does not reconcile nonterminal operation records. Reopening succeeds, increments generation, and new set/get executes while the original operation remains running.
issues.required_fix: Under the exclusive session lock, reconcile durable operation state with the session pointer before starting a replacement incarnation. Refuse ambiguous/nonterminal orphan state without clearing or fabricating outcomes; do not admit fresh execution until continuity is explicitly established. Preserve old records and attempt identity. Retain a bounded regression proving this exact crash window refuses reopen/new dispatch while normal clean restart still works. Acceptance-test edits, if needed, remain owned by the independent author and require renewed seal/review.
